name: Alila Jabal Akhdar
positioning: Clifftop mountain resort more than 6,500 feet up on Oman's Jabal Akhdar, the Green Mountain, with fort-inspired stone architecture about an hour from Nizwa
best_for: Travelers who want a remote, high-altitude mountain escape in Oman
Guests drawn to stargazing, outdoor adventure like the via ferrata, and cultural trips to Nizwa
Wellness seekers who want spa treatments and yoga with mountain views

facts.text: The resort sits in a clifftop setting about an hour outside the ancient city of Nizwa.
Locally sourced materials and classic-style stonework are combined with contemporary architecture.
The suites and villas are built from mountain stone and adorned with hand-painted juniper leaves by local artists.
The spa fuses time-honored Asian healing practices with traditional beauty formulas crafted from natural elements.
The resort's garden is home to one of Oman's first high-altitude hydroponic systems in a luxury resort.
A mountain-to-table cooking experience has guests cook traditional Omani dishes over open flame in an outdoor kitchen.
An excursion to Nizwa takes in its markets, its fort and the ancient alleys of Birkat Almouz.
A via ferrata climbing path is located just beyond the hotel restaurant.
Complimentary activities rotate and include sunrise or sunset yoga on a platform overlooking the mountains.
Juniper restaurant, named after the juniper trees of Oman's highlands, uses fresh, seasonal local produce.
Most of the front office staff are local Omanis who live in nearby villages.

highlights.text: The resort is perched more than 6,500 feet above sea level amid an alpine landscape dominated by Jabal Akhdar, the Green Mountain.
The design takes inspiration from the region's ancient forts, using traditional building techniques, fort-like doors, wooden rafters and Omani design motifs.
A signature wellness experience includes a Balinese massage in a spa pavilion overlooking the canyon, beneath open sky.
Clear skies make stargazing a highlight.
The resort has an expansive infinity pool with views of the Green Mountain and a heated indoor pool.

considerations.text: The property is remote, with not much around it, and the drive from Muscat takes about 2.5 hours.
A 4x4 vehicle is mandatory for the mountain road.
WhataHotel notes limited dining and entertainment options nearby.
